title: PvP rewards
text:
PvP gear took far too long to earn: a full Conquest set needed 240 arena kills, and losing a battle gave no Conquest at all.

⬆️ Arena kills give 5 Conquest (was 3), a three-kill streak 8 more (was 5), and your first arena kill each day gives 25 more
✨ Emberclash Fields now gives Conquest too: 12 for a win, 8 for a draw and 5 for a loss
⬆️ Defeating a player gives 3 Honor (was 1), and your first Emberclash win each day gives 40 more Honor
